focus_areas: Texture consistency of the yellow central disc (granular vs. smooth)

Symmetry and anatomical correctness of petal arrangement

Also, inspect the tips of the petals for any signs of fusion or irregular shaping that deviates from natural biological variance.

To ensure the flower head is a single coherent object without floating petals or disconnected segments, and to check boundary sharpness against the bokeh background.
